FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What type of companies do you work with?

We work with growth-stage and scaling companies facing operational strain—typically post-product-market fit, where complexity starts outpacing structure.

Is this strategy consulting or execution support?

We provide both. Our approach combines clear strategic direction with hands-on execution support to ensure plans don’t just look good on paper but are implemented effectively and deliver measurable results.

How is SaleUnion different from traditional consultancies?

SaleUnion focuses on practical outcomes, not just recommendations. We work closely with your team, prioritize simplicity

How long does an engagement typically last?

Most engagements range from 4 weeks for focused strategy work to 3–6 months for deeper transformation or execution support.

Is pricing fixed or customized?

We offer clear starting packages, but pricing is typically customized based on scope, team involvement, and duration to ensure you only pay for the value you need.
